description: This Java source file defines an abstract base class for subscription events within the Eclipse Ditto project, including methods for JSON serialization and common event properties.

classes.name: AbstractSubscriptionEvent
classes.description: An abstract base class for subscription events, providing common properties and JSON serialization logic. It is package-private and not intended for extension outside the package.

methods.name: getSubscriptionId
methods.description: Returns the subscription ID associated with the event.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of the event.

methods.name: getRevision
methods.description: Returns the revision number, always 0 for subscription events.

methods.name: setRevision
methods.description: Sets the revision number, but for subscription events it returns the same instance as revision is not applicable.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Returns a dummy entity ID as subscription events are not related to a specific entity.

methods.name: getTimestamp
methods.description: Returns an empty Optional as subscription events do not have a timestamp.

methods.name: getMetadata
methods.description: Returns an empty Optional as subscription events do not contain metadata.

methods.name: getDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns the DittoHeaders associated with the event.

methods.name: getManifest
methods.description: Returns the event type as its manifest string.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the event to a JsonObject, including type, subscription ID, and custom payload.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Abstract method to append event-specific data to the JSON payload.
